component.name: IndiChat
component.summary: Fast, secure, production-grade real-time messaging application

description.p: IndiChat is a real-time messaging client designed with a modern user experience, featuring direct and group conversations, delivery and read ticks, audio and video calls, end-to-end media sharing, dynamic GIF search, and stickers.

ul.li: Real-time instant messaging with typing indicators and online presence
WebRTC peer-to-peer audio and high-definition video calls
Instant photo, video, document, and audio message attachments
Searchable Tenor GIFs and multi-CDN sticker collections
Multi-device synchronization and remote session management
Native Linux desktop integration, system tray, and notifications

description.p: Initial production release of IndiChat for Linux desktop.
